name: Knight of Trust
source:
Gerd-Adder is a knight of Burgmüller. King Ellen is informed that there are signs of rebellion. He asks main character to become the bodyguard. But becoming a guard means leaving the knights. There is a knight Schmidt who Gerd enjoys to work together. What will Gerd choose?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
格德·阿德 (Gerd-Adder) 是伯格穆勒 (Burgmüller) 的骑士。艾伦国王得知有叛乱的迹象。他要求主角成为保镖。但成为侍卫就意味着离开骑士团。格尔德喜欢和一位骑士施密特一起工作。格尔德会选择什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
